note: Illustrative deadline policy. Offsets are days relative to the obligation due date; an alert is eligible once now >= due_at + offset_days. Negative offsets are advance warnings. EVC visit reminders (Phase 6.2, FR-20) use the plan's 7/2/1-day cadence; these lead times are Unverified operational placeholders, not AICTE deadlines. The 'appeal' ladder (Phase 3.5, FR-27) drives the day-3 / day-6 reminders as offsets from the window close date and is Unverified placeholder configuration until AICTE confirms the appeal cadence (see appeal_policy.json). The 'compliance' ladder (Phase 4.4, FR-15) drives the PRD s11 deficiency-issued cadence '7d, 2d, due date' (line 281) as offsets from the compliance window close date; the window LENGTH is a labelled placeholder (compliance_policy.json, PRD s19 Q1 open). The 'security_deposit' ladder (Phase 9.2, FR-33) is the PRD §11 day-1/10/14 cadence for the deposit-proof undertaking and applies only after an officer records a linked notice; its window remains placeholder/advisory.
